decisions.evidence: R2 maker: “Saving a link is fast, and its page details get pulled in automatically”; R2 client: “Yes, that matches what I mean.”

decisions.evidence: R2 maker: “add your own tags and a note for context”; R2 client confirms the summary.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker: “You can search to find things later”; R2 client: “Yes, that matches.”

decisions.evidence: R2 maker presents “still to read, done with, and kept but archived”; R2 client confirms.

decisions.evidence: R3 maker: details “fetch automatically the moment you paste”; R3 client: “The automatic lookup feels right.”

decisions.evidence: R3 maker: “Save button only becomes active once a link’s details have loaded”; R3 client: “a link should still be saveable if the lookup fails.”

decisions.evidence: R4 maker presents title and description as “editable fields”; R4 client: “both changes behave the way I want.”
decisions.note: Conforming revised decision for editing fetched metadata before saving.

decisions.evidence: R4 maker allows saving after failed lookup and URL-title fallback; R4 client approves both behaviors.
decisions.note: Conforming revised decision for graceful metadata-fetch failure.

decisions.evidence: R4 maker limits the revision to editing during save; R4 client: “correct these details again after the bookmark has been saved.”

decisions.evidence: R5 maker’s saving-flow summary omits duplicate handling; R5 client: “if I paste a link I’ve already saved… show me the existing bookmark and let me edit it instead.”

decisions.evidence: R6 maker presents loading the existing bookmark and “Update bookmark” with no second copy; R6 client: “that is the behaviour I wanted.”
decisions.note: Conforming revised duplicate-save decision.

decisions.evidence: R7 maker presents To read and Mark done; R7 client: “New links starting in ‘To read’ feels right, and moving them to ‘Done’ is clear.”
decisions.note: Conforming read/unread-state decision.

decisions.evidence: R7 maker presents Delete separately from Archive; R7 client: “permanent removal, distinct from the reversible Archive action.”
decisions.note: Conforming distinction between permanent deletion and reversible archiving.

decisions.evidence: R7 maker: Edit loads a saved bookmark into the update form.
decisions.note: Conforming post-save edit decision.

decisions.evidence: R7 maker presents “To read → Done → Archived” and “Move to To read”; R7 client: archive “should simply hide… while remembering whether it was ‘To read’ or ‘Done’” and restore that state.
decisions.note: Prototype-review correction replacing a sequential third status with an independent, reversible archive flag and archive-only view.

decisions.evidence: R8 maker presents hidden archived items, remembered status, and restoration to that status; R8 client: “this now matches my intent.”
decisions.note: Conforming revised archive behavior.

decisions.evidence: R9 maker makes search span “including Done and Archived”; R9 client: “archived bookmarks should not reappear in an ordinary search… search them deliberately from the Archived view.”
decisions.note: Prototype-review correction restoring archive exclusion and archive-only searching.

decisions.evidence: R9 maker searches “title, note, tags, and site”; R9 client requires “the full link and description as well as the title and note.”

decisions.evidence: R9 maker does not specify case-insensitive matching; R9 client: search “should ignore capitalisation.”
decisions.note: Prototype-review correction adding case-insensitive search.

decisions.evidence: R9 maker makes tags clickable to filter; R9 client: “Clicking a tag to filter by that exact tag feels right.”
decisions.note: Conforming exact-tag filtering decision.

decisions.evidence: R9 maker lacks typed tag syntax; R9 client: “I’d also like to type `#tag` for a tag.”
decisions.note: Prototype-review correction adding tag-query syntax.

decisions.evidence: R9 maker lacks exact-phrase syntax; R9 client requests putting “an exact phrase in quotation marks.”
decisions.note: Prototype-review correction adding quoted exact phrases.

decisions.evidence: R9 maker lacks Boolean/grouped queries; R9 client requests “AND, OR, NOT, and parentheses” with ordinary words and tags combined.
decisions.note: Prototype-review correction adding Boolean operators, grouping, and combined conditions.

decisions.evidence: R10 maker presents case-insensitive matching over title, link, description, and note; R10 client says this behavior matches.

decisions.evidence: R10 maker limits search to the active view and keeps archived matches in Archived; R10 client: “scoped to the current view correctly.”
decisions.note: Conforming revised archive-search scope.

decisions.evidence: R10 maker demonstrates uppercase operators; R10 client: operators “should work regardless of capitalisation” and quoted operators should be literal text.
decisions.note: Prototype-review correction completing Boolean-operator behavior, including the quoted-literal rule.

decisions.evidence: R11 maker demonstrates lowercase operators and quoted `"or"`; R11 client: “search now matches my intent fully.”
decisions.note: Conforming revised Boolean-query decision.

decisions.evidence: R12 maker proposes listing hundreds with scrolling; R12 client rejects “one enormous page” and requests a selectable number shown with manageable groups.

decisions.evidence: R12 maker does not provide persisted collection-display choices; R12 client: “My preferred sort and number shown should be remembered.”
decisions.note: Prototype-review correction adding persisted display preferences.

decisions.note: Conforming revised displayed-items and persistence decision.

decisions.evidence: R14 client requests saving “combinations of search text and included or excluded tags for reuse.”

decisions.evidence: R14 client: “Display preferences should include text size as well as the sort and number shown.”
